name: 27597 · Zebulon, NC
findings: ZIP 27597 (Zebulon) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27597 (Zebulon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27597 (Zebulon) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
